known.title: Functional: Small changes can run only one fixed shard

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - An existing four-group repo runs two Vitest suites in `fast_test`, one with `--shard={group}/{groups}` and the other with `--shard={group}/4`. This check sees `{groups}` anywhere in the command and enables one group, although the second suite still has a fixed denominator. `src/forge/review.py:369` selects the whole fast command, and `src/forge/repo.py:693` substitutes group 1, so a small code change runs only shard 1 of 4 for the second suite. Failing tests in its other shards are omitted while the required `tests` check can pass. The repair test at `tests/test_small_change_runs_one_group.py:29` covers only a standalone fixed-shard command.
findings.title: Functional: Small changes can run only one fixed shard

stop.reason: Owner chose one tiny round: no one-group rule when any fixed shard count is in the command
